description: Get how long a single task has spent in each of its statuses, plus the current status duration. Use to analyze cycle time or where a task is stuck.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires team_id.

task_id.description: ID of the task to analyze.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_task_time_in_status
